title: Please don't replace my dashboard with ai chatbox. Thank you
excerpt: The blank page problem has just been introduced to so many of my favorite products. I don't mind having an option to chat with your AI chatbot thingy, but please give me an out, and don't make it default without asking me.
content_html:
The blank page problem has just been introduced to so many of my favorite products. I don't mind having an option to chat with your AI chatbot thingy, but please give me an out, and don't make it default without asking me.

That is all. Have a nice day.

仅此而已。 祝你今天过得愉快。
